short: Overt-trained ECoG decoding of covert reading (M04), spectral outputs (M08) and the overt-recording covert reference (M11) are standard; DTW-aligned rest reaches r 0.30 vs covert 0.34.
position: The paper [@martin2014] applies an overt-trained ECoG decoder to covert reading (M04, standard: the same transfer design appears earlier with EMG and ultrasound on mouthed speech [@janke2010; @wand2011; @florescu2010silent], while neural covert decoders trained within condition [@pei2011decoding]), outputs spectrogram and modulation features where the one earlier production decoder used two formants [@guenther2009] (M08, standard), and scores covert output against the participant's DTW-aligned overt recording (M11, standard: whispered and NAM conversion was already scored against audible recordings of the same utterance [@tran2010silent], with no earlier neural covert instance in the Appendix check). Most of the covert correlation is the DTW floor (rest 0.30 of covert 0.34), and covert identification beat chance in one of seven subjects.
